case.pattern_description: Unauthorized online transaction reported by customer; confirmed as fraudulent via step-up validation despite low initial risk score.

evidence.claim: Transaction 3581141 was an online purchase with a risk score of 0.28.

case.summary: Customer C08299 reported an unauthorized online transaction of $30.02 on card C08299-K1. Step-up authentication confirmed the customer did not recognize the merchant and remains in possession of the physical card. The transaction is confirmed as Card Not Present fraud.

evidence_requests.assumed_response: Customer confirms they did not authorize the $30.02 charge, do not recognize the merchant, and have the card in their possession.

initial.reason: Customer dispute of specific transaction ID.

final.reason: Confirmed unauthorized use of card C08299-K1.

next_best_actions.what_changed: Step-up validation moved the probability from ambiguous (0.28 risk score vs customer claim) to high certainty of fraud.

sar.reason: Transaction amount ($30.02) is below the regulatory threshold for mandatory SAR filing and no broader structuring or money laundering pattern is identified.

stop_reason: Case resolved via customer validation and card security protocols.
